challenges.title: Build a Data Analysis Dashboard
description: Build a web-based data analysis dashboard that loads a dataset, computes descriptive statistics, and displays visualizations.
User Story: I can upload or provide a dataset (CSV-like structure), and see a summary including count, mean, median, mode, and standard deviation for each numeric column.
User Story: I can filter the dataset by selecting a column value, and the statistics update to reflect the filtered data.
User Story: I can see at least one chart (bar, line, or histogram) that updates based on my filter selection.
Here is a suggested CodePen template to use.
Remember to use Read-Search-Ask if you get stuck.

challenges.title: Build a Predictive Model Explainer
description: Build an interactive tool that demonstrates how a simple machine learning model makes predictions.
User Story: I can input feature values (like age, income, hours studied) and see a prediction output from a simple model (linear regression formula or decision tree logic you implement in JS).
User Story: I can see which input features most influence the output (feature importance visualization).
User Story: I can adjust model parameters (weights/thresholds) and see how predictions change in real time.
The goal of this project is to build intuition about how ML models work — not to use an actual ML library.
Remember to use Read-Search-Ask if you get stuck.
